errorCodes.meaning: No application has this handle in a context the caller may act in.

ApplicationSummary.description: An applicant engine as the VTA holds it, without its key.

applicationId.description: The VTA's handle for this application. Opaque; never sent to the community.

attestations.description: The metadata of each attestation held, in the order received. Metadata names no vetter.

contextId.description: The context the application's key is derived in.

id.description: The applicant's PCS identifier: what a vetter attests to, carried in a vetting/request's `ext`.

joinDid.description: The DID the application joins as.

ApplicationSummary.title: ApplicationSummary

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Multibase.description: A binary value, multibase base58btc over the suite's canonical encoding.
Multibase.title: Multibase

Response.title: VTA PCS — Applications — Show — response payload

StatementMeta.description: What a Vetting Statement would have said, minus its issuer.

cardDigestMultibase.description: Digest of that card, as the vetter verified it.

claimsVerified.description: The claim types the vetter checked.

community.description: The community this attestation is for. An attestation is not portable between communities.

declaredRelationship.description: The relationship the vetter declared, which the community's independence rules count.

identityCommitment.description: The commitment on the Vetting Card the applicant showed. Consistency across attestations is what stops two applicants pooling them.

livenessConfirmed.description: Whether the vetter confirmed a live person.

method.description: How the vetter met the applicant.

requirementsDigest.description: The digest of the criterion's requirements as the vetter read them.

tokenLabel.description: The token label spent, repeated inside the bound facts so it cannot be swapped in transit.

tokenSerial.description: The token serial spent, likewise bound.

validFrom.description: A DATE, never a timestamp: an exact time would let a community line an attestation up with a vetter's activity, which undoes the proof without touching it.

validUntil.description: A date, for the same reason.
